evals.prompt: Design public liveness/readiness and private diagnostics/metrics exposure for a Next.js service behind a trusted reverse proxy.
evals.expected_output: An explicit exposure matrix with minimal public payloads and layered fail-closed protection for private routes.
expectations: Separates public probes from protected diagnostics and metrics.
Uses explicit serializer opt-ins and no-store responses.
Documents and verifies the trusted proxy/header assumption.

evals.prompt: Protect a diagnostics route with bearer auth, allowIps, and allowCidrs, then explain behavior when x-forwarded-for is missing or contains an invalid first value.
evals.expected_output: A fail-closed AND-composed policy with construction and runtime denial tests.
expectations: Requires trustProxy true and valid IPv4/CIDR configuration.
Explains that all configured policy classes must pass.
Expects 401 for missing or invalid proxy address.

evals.prompt: Review a public diagnostics endpoint using includeDetails, redact false, stack traces, request IDs in OTel labels, and custom cache-control public headers.
evals.expected_output: A prioritized security review that closes data, cardinality, and caching leaks.
expectations: Flags non-sanitized metrics/labels and unbounded request IDs.
Moves stack/cause exposure behind protected diagnostics with minimal opt-in.
Preserves no-store and rejects custom cache override.

evals.prompt: Diagnose why includeDetails false still exposes service identity and metrics, while redact false still hides the original error message.
evals.expected_output: A serializer-surface diagnosis that distinguishes details redaction from error policy and unsanitized report fields.
expectations: Explains that includeDetails controls check.details only.
Explains that error messages need explicit includeErrorMessage opt-in.
Identifies identities and metrics as separate unsanitized surfaces.

evals.prompt: Implement the actual Next.js route modules, singleton manager import, GET/HEAD handlers, and strict readiness status for the approved exposure matrix.
evals.expected_output: Composition with the Next.js routes skill while retaining the security acceptance criteria.
expectations: Recognizes route wiring as healthcheck-nextjs-routes work.
Carries protection, redaction, and no-store requirements into the handoff.
Does not invent framework-neutral route APIs.
